name: Khazgorm's Journal
summary: At Bael Modan, Prospector Khazgorm leads the Ironforge dwarven excavation in the southern Barrens. His field ledger records the Explorers' League's work on lands claimed by the Stonespire tauren.

sections.title: A Record of Destruction
sections.body: Prospector Khazgorm directs the heavy machinery and blasting that cut into the southern Barrens hillsides. His notes show an excavation far from the Explorers' League's promised search for knowledge: its work has displaced the Stonespire tribe. The tauren tried to settle matters peacefully, but the dwarves refused. Gann Stonespire wants the journal to understand the Ironforge presence in his homeland and find a way to break it.

sections.title: A Shift in Tactics
sections.body: Gann Stonespire finds the journal among Khazgorm's remains, near the tents and pillars of the digsite. The notes show him how the dwarf expedition is organized, what equipment it uses, and where it is vulnerable. With that knowledge, Gann turns from driving back laborers to striking the excavation's machinery. The journal changes the struggle over Bael Modan.

faq.q: Who does the journal belong to?
faq.answer: The journal belongs to Prospector Khazgorm, a leader of the Ironforge dwarven excavation at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Gann Stonespire want this book?
faq.answer: Gann Stonespire wants the journal to study the plans and secrets of the dwarves who displaced his tribe. Khazgorm's notes help him plan further strikes against the Bael Modan encampment.

faq.q: Where can the journal be found?
faq.answer: Prospector Khazgorm carries the journal among the tents and rock pillars of the active excavation just south of Bael Modan.

faq.q: What does the journal reveal about the dwarves?
faq.answer: The journal shows the Explorers' League's pursuit of buried relics and Titan heritage comes at the direct, violent expense of tribes such as the Stonespire tauren.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see the journal as evidence of the Ironforge invaders' disregard for the Stonespire tribe as they blast its ancestral lands.
As a member of the Horde, you can help Gann Stonespire defend Kalimdor from Alliance expeditions pressing into Horde territory.
